name: rsvelte-check-oracle
description: Isolated environment holding the REAL svelte-check, used as the diagnostic oracle by scripts/compat-corpus/check-verify.mjs, plus the `svelte` / `typescript` / `@sveltejs/kit` its diagnostics are produced against. This node_modules is symlinked into every materialised fixture, so both checkers resolve the same dependency tree. The versions below are EXACT on purpose: the gate compares diagnostic sets against this oracle, so a floating range would let an upstream release move the baseline with no change in this repo. That pins the top level only — installs run with --no-package-lock, so transitive versions are re-resolved each time. Renovate tracks them like any other npm dep. `svelte` matches submodules/svelte; `typescript` is the newest major svelte-check 4.x declares support for (peer `^5 || ^6`) and also supplies the `tsc` that rsvelte-check's TSGO_BIN points at; `@typescript/native` is TypeScript 7 under the npm alias both checkers look it up by (sveltejs/language-tools#3073), installed alongside — not instead of — the TS 6 `typescript`, which is what the `ts7-native` scenario needs.
